join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!admin
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Bad command

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin asdasd
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Bad command asdasd


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin roundtrip
send_match hortbot #foobar ^\[HB\] fromTwitch=.*, inQueue=.*, begin=.*, handle=.*, commit=.*


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin color
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !admin color <color>

twitch_set_chat_color {"UserID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "Color": "green"}
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin color green
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Color set to green.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin syncJoined
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin syncJoined
notify_eventsub_updates
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Triggered channel sync for hortbot.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin syncJoined SomeBot
notify_eventsub_updates
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Triggered channel sync for SomeBot.
